ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you read the syllable نِي? (1 mark)
   A. nii
   B. ba
   C. thaa
   D. ni

2. How do you read the syllable بَ? (1 mark)
   A. sa
   B. bu
   C. ba
   D. bii

3. What does the Arabic word قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) mean? (1 mark)
   A. strong
   B. oranges
   C. friend
   D. in

4. What does the Arabic word نَهْرٌ (nahr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. river
   C. cold
   D. mountain

5. What is the name of the Arabic letter س? (1 mark)
   A. siin
   B. zaay
   C. Daad
   D. qaaf

6. What does the Arabic word ayna ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. What
   C. Who
   D. Why

7. How is the Arabic word عِنْدَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿinda
   B. bijaanibi
   C. ʿalaa
   D. taHta

8. Which Arabic word means "carrots"? (1 mark)
   A. ذُرَةٌ
   B. فَاكِهَةٌ
   C. جَزَرٌ
   D. مَوْزٌ

9. Which Arabic sentence means "Do you like bananas?" (1 mark)
   A. هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟
   B. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   C. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   D. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ

10. Which word fills the gap in: ashrabu ____ (I drink the juice)? (1 mark)
   A. al-kaʿka
   B. baaluun
   C. al-hafla
   D. al-ʿasiira

11. Which Arabic word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. خَالَةٌ
   B. قَدَمٌ
   C. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   D. صَغِيرٌ

12. How is the Arabic word قَدَمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. katif
   B. qadam
   C. sinn
   D. udhun

13. How is the Arabic word حَدِيقَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. kuub
   B. saaʿa
   C. matbakh
   D. hadiiqa

14. What does the Arabic sentence مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. How beautiful the environment is!
   B. The sun is in the sky.
   C. We dance.
   D. And the rain is from the sky.

15. Which Arabic sentence means "This is rain." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ
   B. الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ
   C. الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ
   D. هَذَا مَطَرٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (2 marks)

17. Explain why we celebrate special occasions and how pictures help us to understand a text. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into English: nahnu narqusu (2 marks)

19. Translate into English: anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii (2 marks)

21. List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — nii
   نِي is read nii.

2. C — ba
   بَ is read ba.

3. A — strong
   قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) means strong.

4. B — river
   نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

5. A — siin
   The letter س is called siin.

6. A — Where
   ayna means 'where'.

7. A — ʿinda
   عِنْدَ is read ʿinda and means at (near, by).

8. C — جَزَرٌ
   جَزَرٌ (jazar) means carrots.

9. A — هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟
   هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

10. D — al-ʿasiira
   We drink juice, not cake, a party or a balloon.

11. D — صَغِيرٌ
   صَغِيرٌ (Sagiir) means small.

12. B — qadam
   قَدَمٌ is read qadam and means foot.

13. D — hadiiqa
   حَدِيقَةٌ is read hadiiqa and means garden.

14. A — How beautiful the environment is!
   مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ (maa ajmala l-bii'a) means: How beautiful the environment is!

15. D — هَذَا مَطَرٌ
   هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: I go to school on Monday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Celebrations bring people together and give joy. Pictures show what a text is about and act as clues to new words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for celebrations and 2 marks for pictures as clues.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: We dance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am in Grade 4.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: I write with my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (4 marks)
   Answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.
